shortTitle: AAST Supplemental Low Flow Oxygen & Titration Competency
sourceIdentityNote: AAST currently lists Supplemental Low Flow Oxygen and Titration among its sleep-technologist Core Competencies. This record is a professional competency source, not an AAST Technical Guideline.
bestFor: Professional competency expectations related to applying, monitoring, and titrating supplemental low-flow oxygen within sleep-technology practice and applicable physician/facility protocols.

mappingRationale.D4C: Directly corresponds to the BRPT task family for administering oxygen therapy and to AAST's named sleep-technologist competency in supplemental low-flow oxygen and titration.

authorityBoundary: Defines a competency expectation, not a universal oxygen titration algorithm. Oxygen administration requires the applicable physician order, indication-specific current professional guidance, facility policy/protocol, professional scope and state-law limits, and manufacturer/device instructions where relevant. PAP-titration oxygen procedures must remain separate from CSA, hypoventilation, pediatric/infant, and other ordered-oxygen pathways.
copyrightUse: Use source identity, competency title, original study objectives, and concise professional-scope summaries. Do not invent procedural thresholds or reproduce inaccessible competency text without verification.
